name: Ricardo Garcia
bio: Ricardo's passion for motorsport ignited early, fuelled by his grandfather's stories of working as a mechanic during the golden age of rallying. He honed his skills through vocational training specializing in automotive refinishing, with a focus on advanced painting techniques. Ricardo approaches his role with meticulous attention to detail, understanding that a flawless paint job isn't just about aesthetics; it's about aerodynamics and brand representation. His dedication to quality and unwavering focus distinguish him as a valuable asset to any team. He is known to be calm under pressure.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight fade
physical.description: Ricardo is of average height with a lean, athletic build.

quirks: Whistles softly while applying clear coat.
Carries a small, well-worn book of automotive paint codes from the 1970s.
